create_instance: create an Instance object with an index, dataloader, and args namespace for evaluating a source-target pair
summarize_instance: summarize an Instance by returning a dictionary with prediction, delays, elapsed, and source metrics
send_source_segment: send a source segment from a TextInputInstance or SpeechInputInstance advancing the step and returning a segment
receive_prediction: receive a prediction segment from an agent and update the prediction list, elapsed times, and delays
build_instance_from_json: build an Instance from a JSON string by deserializing prediction, delays, elapsed, and reference fields
